note: Hard filters applied BEFORE any AHP suitability scoring. A candidate site failing ANY criterion is removed from consideration entirely, regardless of its score on other factors.

criteria.description: Site polygon intersects any Red or Orange hazard zone, of any hazard type.
Site intersects Coastal Regulation Zone I (ecologically sensitive area / area between High Tide Line and Low Tide Line).
Site intersects notified reserved/protected forest land.
Site intersects the 100-year (1% annual exceedance probability) river floodplain.
Site's mean slope exceeds 20 degrees, making it unbuildable without disproportionate earthwork.
Site falls within the exclusion buffer of a known active geological fault line.
Site falls within the no-build buffer of a river, lake, or reservoir.
Site intersects an active or pending mining lease area.
